name: JavaScript - First Steps
description: Your first encounter with JavaScript - learn about variables and output

rules.text: Create a paragraph with an id for output
rules.hint: Start with HTML: <p id="output">This will change</p>. We'll use JavaScript to modify this text!

rules.text: Add a <script> tag to your HTML
rules.hint: JavaScript goes inside <script> tags! Add: <script></script> after your paragraph. This is where we'll write JavaScript code.

rules.text: Create a variable and display it in the paragraph
rules.hint: Inside script tags, write: let message = "Hello JavaScript!"; document.getElementById("output").innerHTML = message; This shows the variable on the page!

completion.message: 🎉 Great start! You've learned about JavaScript variables and output!
